title: Equal Score Substrings
summary: Given a string of lowercase letters, calculate if it can be divided into two non-empty parts with equal scores, where each letter's score is its position in the alphabet.
statement: Given a string of lowercase letters, calculate if it can be divided into two non-empty parts with equal scores, where each letter's score is its position in the alphabet.
constraints: Score a through z as one through twenty-six.
Split s into two nonempty contiguous parts.
Return whether any split gives equal score sums.
hints: Move characters one at a time into a prefix accumulator, stopping before the final character.
At each legal split compare prefix with total-prefix.
Equality at any point proves the required division.
editorial: Equality at any point proves the required division.

tests.explanation: No nonempty split has equal scores.
